messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: High p50/p95 token latency observed in eu-west for economy tier starting ~09:12 UTC. Alert: latency.p95 > 800ms for 5m. Auto-escalation to oncall.
maya: oncall here, pulling graphs now. seeing a sustained increase in p95 and CPU on economy nodes in eu-west cluster. p50 also creeping up. no obvious 502s yet.
ian: looking at routing logs — there's a ~3x increase in economy traffic from apac->eu imports (cross-region) causing KV thrash. spike correlates with a mobile feature flag rollout from a partner customer.
maya: ok. customer-impact: economy users in EU might see slower completions; premium unaffected. support queue trending up for 30m. tagging @jamie to prep status message if we mitigate or need outages.
jamie (support): copying. I'll draft a short notice but hold until we have mitigation. any ETA? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
devlin: I can flip a regional steering policy to move economy->us-west (lower latency cost tradeoff) for a subset of traffic for a quick relief. suggest surgical steering of 30% of economy sessions off eu-west for 15m then reassess.
maya: agree. also consider temporary rate limiting on economy tokens per-minute in eu-west to blunt bursts. combine steering + soft ratecap.
ian: suggested steps:
1) apply routing delta: steer 30% economy sessions from eu-west -> us-west
2) apply soft rate limit for economy in eu-west: 20 requests/min per API key (no change to premium)
3) monitor p50/p95 and error budgets for 10m
4) if stable, slowly reduce steering back
5) if not, escalate to full 60% steer and open customer notifications
maya: who takes the route change? devlin?
devlin: I'll run the route change. using internal control-plane API. patch below (will run in canary then global):
```
# curl to internal admin
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/adjust \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"selector": {"tier":"economy","region":"eu-west"}, "action": "steer", "target": {"region":"us-west","percentage":30}, "note":"surgical-mitigation-1746012345"}'
```
I'll run canary (10%) then full 30% if telemetry looks good.
ops-bot: Executing canary steering job id=steer-1746012345-c1 -> 10% applied. watch: https://metrics.internal/dashboards/1746012345
devlin: canary applied. pinging monitors.
ian: seeing immediate drop in CPU on a subset of eu-west nodes. p95 went from 920ms -> 680ms for canary cohort.
maya: good signal. proceed to 30%.
ops-bot: Scaling steering to 30%... done. job id=steer-1746012345-c2. New watch link: https://metrics.internal/d/steer-1746012345
ian: p95 now at ~520ms overall, p50 back to ~120ms. errors unchanged. economy token throughput down ~18% in eu-west which is expected.
maya: now applying soft rate limit on eu-west economy keys. I'll patch runtime config.
```
# runtime admin
PATCH /v1/config/quotas
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "scope":"region:eu-west,tier:economy",
  "quota": {"requests_per_minute_per_key": 20},
  "mode": "soft"
}
```
ops-bot: quota patch accepted (tx id=quota-1746012345). enforcement in ~30s.
jamie (support): preparing a user-facing note: "We temporarily adjusted routing for lower-tier traffic in EU to maintain overall responsiveness. Premium customers unaffected." will wait 10m to confirm.
tara: adding a tracing tag to the steered sessions so we can correlate regressions with customer IDs. pushing a lightweight header: X-Routed-From: eu-west-steer-1746012345.
devlin: header added at control-plane layer.
ian: monitoring 5m window: p95 stable ~500-550ms, no increase in 5xx. request queue length in eu-west down. CPU headroom regained.
maya: status: mitigation successful for now. next actions: (1) keep steering at 30% + soft ratecap for 20m, (2) rotate oncall in 30m for longer tail monitoring, (3) support to send the note if stable, (4) create follow-up ticket to roll back partner rollout causing cross-region imports.
jamie (support): I'll hold the note pending 20m stable then send to EU customers impacted by economy tier. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: alert: latency.p95 eu-west economy cleared. closing the critical pager. follow-up channel: #postmortems.
maya: leaving a handoff: @ian will cover next 30m. i'm logging incident summary in ops-runbook and creating incident postmortem stub.
ian: ack. I'll monitor and escalate if we see recurrence.
devlin: add a followup to evaluate long-term routing weights and whether we should add a hard quota for economy during imports. created ticket INF-4521.
maya: thanks team. nice quick surgical mitigation. moving thread to postmortem drafting. :rocket:
